mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warning_log (user_id, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, NOW(), #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warning_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expires_at > NOW()
SELECT ban_policy_id AS banPolicyId, code, warning_no AS warningNo, ban_type AS banType, ban_days AS banDays, description FROM ban_policy WHERE warning_no = #{warningNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ban_log (user_id, warning_no, source, ban_type, starts_at, ends_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{warningNo}, 'auto', #{banType}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, NOW())
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log r JOIN posts hp ON r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = hp.post_id WHERE hp.user_id = u.user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log r JOIN comments hc ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND r.target_id = hc.comment_id WHERE hc.user_id = u.user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moderation_log m JOIN posts hp ON m.target_type = 'post' AND m.target_id = hp.post_id WHERE hp.user_id = u.user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moderation_log m JOIN comments hc ON m.target_type = 'comment' AND m.target_id = hc.comment_id WHERE hc.user_id = u.user_id)
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM penalty_log pl WHERE pl.user_id = u.user_id AND pl.voided_at IS NULL AND pl.expires_at > NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.name, u.email, u.ban_status AS banStatus, u.banned_until AS bannedUntil, (SELECT bl.starts_at FROM ban_log bl WHERE bl.user_id = u.user_id AND bl.lifted_at IS NULL ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS banStartedAt, CASE WHEN u.ban_status = 'permanent' THEN 'permanent' WHEN u.ban_status = 'temporary' THEN 'temporary' WHEN THEN 'caution' ELSE 'history' END AS tag FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND ( u.ban_status != 'none' OR OR ) ORDER BY u.user_id DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.name, u.email, u.ban_status AS banStatus, u.banned_until AS bannedUntil, (SELECT bl.starts_at FROM ban_log bl WHERE bl.user_id = u.user_id AND bl.lifted_at IS NULL ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS banStartedAt, CASE WHEN u.ban_status = 'permanent' THEN 'permanent' WHEN u.ban_status = 'temporary' THEN 'temporary' WHEN THEN 'caution' WHEN THEN 'history' ELSE 'none' END AS tag FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE ban_status = 'temporary' AND banned_until <= NOW()
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log q WHERE q.target_type = ${tt} AND q.target_id = m.target_id AND q.source <> 'admin' AND q.created_at <= m.created_at)
mapper.select: SELECT 'report' AS eventType, r.created_at AS eventAt, r.report_id AS reportId, r.status AS reportStatus, NULL AS actionId, ru.name AS reporterName, NULL AS actorName, 0 AS isAuto, 0 AS reported, rs.label AS reasonLabel, r.detail AS detail, p.post_id AS postId, NULL AS commentId, bd.board_id AS boardId, bd.name AS boardName, p.title AS title, LEFT(p.content, 30) AS preview, p.state AS state, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log x WHERE x.target_type = 'post' AND x.target_id = p.post_id AND x.status <> 'rejected') AS listedInReports FROM reports_log r JOIN posts p ON r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN boards bd ON bd.board_id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON rs.reason_id = r.reason_id LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = r.reporter_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND r.source <> 'admin' UNION ALL SELECT CASE m.applied_state WHEN 'blind' THEN 'blind' WHEN 'deleted' THEN 'delete' ELSE 'restore' END AS eventType, m.created_at AS eventAt, NULL AS reportId, NULL AS reportStatus, m.action_id AS actionId, NULL AS reporterName, au.name AS actorName, (m.acted_by IS NULL) AS isAuto, AS reported, rs.label AS reasonLabel, m.detail AS detail, p.post_id AS postId, NULL AS commentId, bd.board_id AS boardId, bd.name AS boardName, p.title AS title, LEFT(p.content, 30) AS preview, p.state AS state, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log x WHERE x.target_type = 'post' AND x.target_id = p.post_id AND x.status <> 'rejected') AS listedInReports FROM moderation_log m JOIN posts p ON m.target_type = 'post' AND m.target_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN boards bd ON bd.board_id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON rs.reason_id = m.reason_id LEFT JOIN users au ON au.user_id = m.acted_by WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND m.applied_state IN ('blind', 'deleted', 'normal') ORDER BY eventAt DESC, actionId DESC, reportId DESC

SELECT 'report' AS eventType, r.created_at AS eventAt, r.report_id AS reportId, r.status AS reportStatus, NULL AS actionId, ru.name AS reporterName, NULL AS actorName, 0 AS isAuto, 0 AS reported, rs.label AS reasonLabel, r.detail AS detail, cp.post_id AS postId, c.comment_id AS commentId, bd.board_id AS boardId, bd.name AS boardName, cp.title AS title, LEFT(c.content, 30) AS preview, c.state AS state, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log x WHERE x.target_type = 'comment' AND x.target_id = c.comment_id AND x.status <> 'rejected') AS listedInReports FROM reports_log r JOIN comments c ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND r.target_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN posts cp ON cp.post_id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN boards bd ON bd.board_id = cp.board_id LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON rs.reason_id = r.reason_id LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = r.reporter_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND r.source <> 'admin' UNION ALL SELECT CASE m.applied_state WHEN 'blind' THEN 'blind' WHEN 'deleted' THEN 'delete' ELSE 'restore' END AS eventType, m.created_at AS eventAt, NULL AS reportId, NULL AS reportStatus, m.action_id AS actionId, NULL AS reporterName, au.name AS actorName, (m.acted_by IS NULL) AS isAuto, AS reported, rs.label AS reasonLabel, m.detail AS detail, cp.post_id AS postId, c.comment_id AS commentId, bd.board_id AS boardId, bd.name AS boardName, cp.title AS title, LEFT(c.content, 30) AS preview, c.state AS state, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports_log x WHERE x.target_type = 'comment' AND x.target_id = c.comment_id AND x.status <> 'rejected') AS listedInReports FROM moderation_log m JOIN comments c ON m.target_type = 'comment' AND m.target_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN posts cp ON cp.post_id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN boards bd ON bd.board_id = cp.board_id LEFT JOIN reasons rs ON rs.reason_id = m.reason_id LEFT JOIN users au ON au.user_id = m.acted_by WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND m.applied_state IN ('blind', 'deleted', 'normal') ORDER BY eventAt DESC, actionId DESC, reportId DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports_log r LEFT JOIN posts pb ON r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = pb.post_id LEFT JOIN comments c ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND r.target_id = c.comment_id WHERE COALESCE(pb.user_id, c.user_id) = #{userId} AND r.resolution_action_id IS NOT NULL
